title: Discovery of indole-2-one derivatives as BRD4 (BD1) selective inhibitors.
authors: Qiao, Xue-Peng; Wang, Xue-Ting; Wang, Shuai; Mu, Hong-Xia; Wang, Qing-Shan; Chen, Shi-Wu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BRD4溴结构域小分子抑制剂的设计与抗肿瘤活性，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: Bromodomain protein 4 (BRD4) is a member of the BET family, and its overexpression is closely associated with the development of many tumors. Inhibition of BRD4 shows great therapeutic potential in anti-tumor, and pan-BRD4 inhibitors show adverse effects of dose limiting toxicity and thrombocytopenia in clinical trials. To improve clinical effects and reduce side effects, more efforts have focused on seeking selective inhibitors of BD1 or BD2. Herein, a series of indole-2-one derivatives were designed and synthesized through docking-guided optimization to find BRD4-BD1 selective inhibitors, and their BRD4 inhibitory and antiproliferation activities were evaluated. Among them, compound 21r had potent BRD4 inhibitory activity (the IC(50) values of 41 nM and 313 nM in BD1 and BD2 domain), excellent anti-proliferation (the IC(50) values of 4.64 +/- 0.30 microM, 0.78 +/- 0.03 microM, 5.57 +/- 1.03 microM against HL-60, MV-4-11 and HT-29 cells), and displayed low toxicity against normal cell GES-1 cells. Further studies revealed that 21r inhibited proliferation by decreasing the expression of proto-oncogene c-Myc, blocking cell cycle in G(0)/G(1) phase, and inducing apoptosis in MV-4-11 cells in a dose-dependent manner. All the results showed that compound 21r was a potent BRD4 inhibitor with BD1 selectivity, which had potential in treatment of leukemia.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）是BET家族的一员，其过表达与多种肿瘤的发生密切相关。抑制BRD4在抗肿瘤方面显示出巨大的治疗潜力，但泛BRD4抑制剂在临床试验中表现出剂量限制性毒性和血小板减少症等不良反应。为了改善临床效果并减少副作用，更多研究致力于寻找BD1或BD2的选择性抑制剂。在此，通过对接引导的优化设计并合成了一系列吲哚-2-酮衍生物，以寻找BRD4-BD1选择性抑制剂，并评估了它们的BRD4抑制活性和抗增殖活性。其中，化合物21r具有强效的BRD4抑制活性（在BD1和BD2结构域中的IC(50)值分别为41 nM和313 nM），优异的抗增殖活性（对HL-60、MV-4-11和HT-29细胞的IC(50)值分别为4.64 ± 0.30 μM、0.78 ± 0.03 μM、5.57 ± 1.03 μM），并对正常细胞GES-1细胞表现出低毒性。进一步研究表明，21r通过降低原癌基因c-Myc的表达、阻滞细胞周期于G(0)/G(1)期，并以剂量依赖性方式诱导MV-4-11细胞凋亡来抑制增殖。所有结果表明，化合物21r是一种具有BD1选择性的强效BRD4抑制剂，在白血病治疗中具有潜在应用价值。
